title: How Maison de Sabré built a cult business of bag charms from scraps

paragraphs.text: Maison de Sabré has spent nearly a decade building a reputation for colorful, beautifully crafted leather handbags. But lately, the thing that makes people fall for the brand isn’t a bag at all—it’s the charms.
paragraphs.translation: Maison de Sabré 花了近十年時間，打造出繽紛多彩、做工精緻的皮革手袋口碑。但最近讓人們愛上這個品牌的，根本不是包包本身，而是那些吊飾。

paragraphs.text: Its newest collection features tiny, intricate leather flowers—cherry blossoms, sunflowers, and daisies—that clip onto a strap, adding a jolt of personality to an otherwise formal bag. There’s also a bumblebee and a snail to round out the garden themes. Last season’s collection included jewel-toned fruits and vegetables: snap peas, carrots, chilis, and mushrooms. A recent Pikachu capsule, timed to Pokémon’s 30th anniversary, sold out almost immediately.
paragraphs.translation: 最新系列推出了細緻精巧的皮革花朵吊飾——櫻花、向日葵與雛菊——可以扣在包帶上，為原本正式的包款注入一股個性。系列中還有大黃蜂與蝸牛，為花園主題畫下句點。上一季的系列則是寶石色澤的蔬果造型：豌豆莢、紅蘿蔔、辣椒與蘑菇。近期推出、配合寶可夢30週年推出的皮卡丘聯名系列，幾乎一上市就售罄。

paragraphs.text: What most customers don’t realize is that those charms are born on the cutting-room floor, from the scraps of colorful leather left from other bags. These offcuts are part of an ongoing “Sabrémoji” charm line that keeps Maison de Sabré customers coming back to the brand season after season. Since they’re limited-edition offerings—dependent on what offcuts are currently available—they’ve also become collectibles. It’s a waste-prevention strategy that generates sales and lets customers personalize a classic bag.
paragraphs.translation: 大多數顧客沒發現的是，這些吊飾其實誕生於裁剪室的地板上，來自其他包款裁剪後留下的彩色皮革邊角料。這些下腳料構成了持續推出的「Sabrémoji」吊飾系列，讓 Maison de Sabré 的顧客季復一季不斷回購。由於這些吊飾是限量發行——取決於當下有哪些邊角料可用——這也讓它們成為收藏品。這是一套既能防止浪費、又能創造銷售，同時讓顧客為經典包款增添個人風格的策略。

paragraphs.text: The clearest sign of how central those charms are to the brand’s identity is the newest bag in the collection. Maison de Sabré recently launched the Soft Trio, a crossbody deliberately designed with clasps and hooks to show off the charms. It’s part of the company’s broader ambition of building the next generation of luxury brand, where sustainability is a central value.
paragraphs.translation: 這些吊飾對品牌識別有多重要，從系列中最新款的包包就能看得最清楚。Maison de Sabré 最近推出了 Soft Trio，一款刻意設計了扣環與掛鉤、用來展示吊飾的斜背包。這是該公司更宏大企圖心的一部分——打造以永續為核心價值的下一代奢侈品牌。

paragraphs.text: Maison de Sabré was founded by brothers Omar and Zane Sabré, who grew up in New Zealand. They originally trained as dentists, but when their father got sick, they realized they didn’t want to spend their lives pursuing careers that weren’t emotionally satisfying to them. As they talked about the future, they discovered a mutual passion for building a luxury brand that would carry their family name and outlive them.
paragraphs.translation: Maison de Sabré 由在紐西蘭長大的 Omar 與 Zane Sabré 兄弟創立。兩人原本受訓成為牙醫，但在父親生病後，他們意識到自己不想把一生耗費在無法帶來情感滿足的職業上。在討論未來的過程中，他們發現彼此都有共同的熱情——打造一個能延續家族姓氏、比自己活得更久的奢侈品牌。

paragraphs.text: They poured $40,000 of savings into their new label, which launched out of Australia. Its very first product, a line of colorful, leather-wrapped iPhone cases, generated $2 million in revenue in its first year. After six years of selling directly to consumers, the company—entirely self-funded—has now expanded into retailers like Nordstrom, Bloomingdale’s, Saks, and Le Bon Marché in Paris. This has accelerated their growth over the past three years. Today, the U.S. is their biggest market.
paragraphs.translation: 他們將4萬美元的積蓄全數投入這個從澳洲起家的新品牌。第一項產品是一系列色彩繽紛、以皮革包覆的 iPhone 手機殼，第一年就創造了200萬美元的營收。在直接面對消費者銷售六年後，這家完全自籌資金的公司如今已進駐 Nordstrom、Bloomingdale's、Saks，以及巴黎的 Le Bon Marché 等零售商。這讓他們在過去三年間加速成長。如今，美國是他們最大的市場。

paragraphs.text: The Sabré brothers have spent a lot of time thinking about what a modern luxury brand should be. Like older generations of luxury consumers, millennials and Gen Zers prize beauty, good design, and durability, but they also expect luxury to be joyful, sustainable, and fairly priced. (Maison de Sabré bags cost $400 to $800, which is between a third and a quarter of the price of brands like Louis Vuitton and Chanel, even though they use similar-quality leather.)
paragraphs.translation: Sabré 兄弟花了大量時間思考現代奢侈品牌該是什麼樣貌。如同上一代的奢侈品消費者，千禧世代與Z世代同樣重視美感、優良設計與耐用度，但他們同時也期待奢侈品能帶來愉悅感、具永續性，且價格公道。（Maison de Sabré 的包款售價落在400至800美元之間，僅為 Louis Vuitton 與 Chanel 等品牌的三分之一到四分之一，儘管使用的皮革品質相近。）
